name: 98037 · Lynnwood, WA
findings: ZIP 98037 (Lynnwood) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98037 (Lynnwood) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98037 (Lynnwood) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
